top_signals.title: CrowdStrike jumps 11% on record second quarter as 'Mythos moment' drives AI cyber wave
top_signals.summary: CrowdStrike shares have surged 61% this year to new highs as the threat from frontier AI has fueled demand for advanced security tools.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Private Equity Firms Find a New Way to Ride Out Cash Crunch
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Laura Benitez joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Private equity managers are using structured equity deals to placate investors frustrated by a lack of cash returns, as many firms struggle to exit investments and send money back to investors. (Source: Bloomberg)
